meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to a local model and save API costs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to run your AI assistant locally and cut API costs.

howto.what: 把某个 NanoClaw 智能体组从 Anthropic API 切到本机 Ollama 模型:改写 container.json 的环境变量、在 settings.json 里设好模型名、重建并重启服务,再验证容器确实走了 Ollama。
howto.when: 当你想让智能体在本机运行、降低 API 花费或试验开放权重模型时使用;前提是 Ollama 已安装并运行、所需模型已拉取、智能体组已存在。

howto.what_en: Switches a NanoClaw agent group from the Anthropic API to a local Ollama model: edits container.json env vars, sets the model in settings.json, rebuilds and restarts the service, then verifies the container.
howto.when_en: Use when you want your agent to run locally, cut API costs, or try open-weight models. Requires Ollama running on the host with the model pulled, and an existing agent group.
